Focused re-verification found secondary reporting of the FY2024 brand shares and a presentation-derived brand roster. The issuer index confirms the relevant conference presentation date, but no primary issuer brand-share methodology or audited brand breakdown was located.
The FY2024 percentages come from secondary analysis rather than an issuer-audited brand-revenue breakdown; the source does not explain its attribution methodology.
The denominator is described as 百和 revenue. No geographic market definition is provided, so these percentages must not be read as global or regional footwear-market shares.
Hoka is supported by a brand roster reproduced from investor-presentation material, not by a quantified revenue disclosure.
The claim itself gives no period; the percentages are pinned here to FY2024 based on the source.
